def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    cw = [[grid[n - 1 - c][r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    ccw = [[grid[c][n - 1 - r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    half = [row[:] for row in grid] + [row[:] for row in ccw]
    for r in range(n):
        half[r].extend(cw[r])
        half[n + r].extend([grid[n - 1 - r][n - 1 - c] for c in range(n)])
    return half
